Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so procurement can kick off the vendor setup:

- Action items we noted on the call:
  1) Clearpath to send signed W-9 and ACH details to Redwood AP (accounts-payable@clearpath.ai was the address you mentioned) — we can accept PDF.
  2) I will generate the vendor onboarding packet (vendor info sheet + next steps) and share the portal invite; your procurement team will use the portal to complete tax/PO setup.
  3) Target onboarding window: start of Dec (ideally Dec 1) so your team can begin testing the Dedicated instance the week after.

Could you confirm: is vendor activation still a priority for Clearpath this month? If so, can you please loop in whoever owns vendor onboarding in finance (name + email) so I can send the portal invite directly? If you prefer, I can also forward the vendor portal invite to the vendor contact once I have the AP email.

Attaching the Redwood vendor info sheet and a short checklist so procurement has everything up front. I cc'd Vivek for visibility on the timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.

—

Mina — thanks for the notes and the packet. Quick answers from my side:

- We do want to prioritize onboarding in December but I need to confirm a couple of procurement items first.
- I looped in AP (see cc). They handle the W-9 + ACH intake and portal acceptance.

Two asks for Redwood to help speed things up:
1) Can you confirm the legal business name and tax ID we should use on the vendor record? (I can share that with AP.)
2) Will the portal invite be sent to a specific vendor email (e.g., vendors@clearpath.ai) or to an individual's address? AP prefers an individual to be the portal owner.

I expect procurement to respond within 3–5 business days. If you want to send the vendor portal invite now to the individual once I provide the contact, that would be helpful.
